core_obligations: Translate the abstract setting (proof lines 21749-21756): by the fppf-etale comparison lemma the lemmas of the comparison section of the sites chapter apply, and the category A_X there is the essential image of a_X^{-1}.
Part (1) (proof lines 21758-21759): the two assertions are equivalent to the condition (V_n) for all n, which is the general V-C lemma for the current setting.
Part (2) (proof lines 21761-21762): apply epsilon_Y^{-1} to the conclusion of the general V-implies-C lemma.

Part (3) and part (4) (proof lines 21764-21769): both follow from the corresponding parts of the general V-C lemma, using that pi_X^{-1}K lies in the appropriate bounded below category and that a_X^{-1} factors through epsilon_X^{-1}.

Part (5) (proof lines 21770-21818): compute R epsilon_{Y,*} R f_{big,fppf,*} a_X^{-1}K in four steps — the push-pull diagram with the composition lemma, part (3), the proper comparison lemma part (2), and part (3) again — so that the base change map becomes an isomorphism after applying R epsilon_{Y,*}; conclude with the remark that a map a_Y^{-1}L -> M whose image under R epsilon_{Y,*} is an isomorphism is itself an isomorphism, proved by induction on i using the vanishing of the higher direct images of the cohomology sheaves in the already-treated degrees and the fact that epsilon_{Y,*} reflects isomorphisms.
proof_roadmap: Specialise the general comparison lemmas to the etale-fppf setting and identify the category A_X as the essential image of a_X^{-1}.
Read parts (1) and (2) off the general V-C and V-implies-C lemmas, and parts (3) and (4) off the general V-C lemma.

For part (5), compare both sides after applying R epsilon_{Y,*} through the push-pull diagram and the proper comparison, then use the spectral-sequence induction showing that R epsilon_{Y,*} reflects isomorphisms for maps out of a_Y^{-1}.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the etale-fppf shadow of the general V and C conditions: it records the vanishing of R^i epsilon_{X,*} on a_X^{-1} of an etale sheaf and the four comparison statements for small and big pushforwards along finite and proper morphisms (statement lines 21724-21746). The proof (proof lines 21748-21818) is mostly transport of the abstract comparison lemmas, but part (5) carries real content: a four-term computation after applying R epsilon_{Y,*}, followed by the induction on i showing that a map a_Y^{-1}L -> M is an isomorphism as soon as R epsilon_{Y,*} of it is, using the vanishing of the higher direct images of the cohomology sheaves. H2: four transports plus one induction, all written out.
